versos.hebraico: אַחַ֣ר׀ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה הָיָ֤ה דְבַר־יְהוָה֙ אֶל־אַבְרָ֔ם בַּֽמַּחֲזֶ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר אַל־תִּירָ֣א אַבְרָ֗ם אָנֹכִי֙ מָגֵ֣ן לָ֔ךְ שְׂכָרְךָ֖ הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃

controles.web: After these things Yahweh’s word came to Abram in a vision, saying, “Don’t be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward.”
controles.kjv: After these things the word of the Lord came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.
controles.livre: Depois destas coisas a palavra do SENHOR veio a Abrão em visão, dizendo: Não temas, Abrão; eu sou o teu escudo; a tua recompensa será muito grande.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אַבְרָ֗ם אֲדֹנָ֤י יֱהוִה֙ מַה־תִּתֶּן־לִ֔י וְאָנֹכִ֖י הוֹלֵ֣ךְ עֲרִירִ֑י וּבֶן־מֶ֣שֶׁק בֵּיתִ֔י ה֖וּא דַּמֶּ֥שֶׂק אֱלִיעֶֽזֶר׃

controles.web: Abram said, “Lord Yahweh, what will you give me, since I go childless, and he who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?”
controles.kjv: And Abram said, Lord God, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus?
controles.livre: Abrão respondeu: Senhor DEUS, que me darás, sendo que não tenho filho, e o herdeiro  da minha casa é Eliézer de Damasco?

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אַבְרָ֔ם הֵ֣ן לִ֔י לֹ֥א נָתַ֖תָּה זָ֑רַע וְהִנֵּ֥ה בֶן־בֵּיתִ֖י יוֹרֵ֥שׁ אֹתִֽי׃

controles.web: Abram said, “Behold, to me you have given no seed: and, behold, one born in my house is my heir.”
controles.kjv: And Abram said, Behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and, lo, one born in my house is mine heir.
controles.livre: Disse mais Abrão: Eis que não me deste descendência, e eis que meu herdeiro é um nascido em minha casa.

versos.hebraico: וְהִנֵּ֨ה דְבַר־יְהוָ֤ה אֵלָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹ֥א יִֽירָשְׁךָ֖ זֶ֑ה כִּי־אִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵצֵ֣א מִמֵּעֶ֔יךָ ה֖וּא יִֽירָשֶֽׁךָ׃

controles.web: Behold, Yahweh’s word came to him, saying, “This man will not be your heir, but he who will come out of your own body will be your heir.”
controles.kjv: And, behold, the word of the Lord came unto him, saying, This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.
controles.livre: E logo a palavra do SENHOR veio a ele dizendo: Não esse não herdará de ti, mas sim o que sairá de tuas entranhas será o que de ti herdará.

versos.hebraico: וַיּוֹצֵ֨א אֹת֜וֹ הַח֗וּצָה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הַבֶּט־נָ֣א הַשָּׁמַ֗יְמָה וּסְפֹר֙ הַכּ֣וֹכָבִ֔ים אִם־תּוּכַ֖ל לִסְפֹּ֣ר אֹתָ֑ם וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ כֹּ֥ה יִהְיֶ֖ה זַרְעֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Yahweh brought him outside, and said, “Look now toward the sky, and count the stars, if you are able to count them.” He said to Abram, “So will your seed be.”
controles.kjv: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.
controles.livre: E tirou-lhe fora, e disse: Olha agora aos céus, e conta as estrelas, se as podes contar. E lhe disse: Assim será tua descendência.

versos.hebraico: וְהֶאֱמִ֖ן בַּֽיהוָ֑ה וַיַּחְשְׁבֶ֥הָ לּ֖וֹ צְדָקָֽה׃

controles.web: He believed in Yahweh; and he reckoned it to him for righteousness.
controles.kjv: And he believed in the Lord; and he counted it to him for righteousness.
controles.livre: E creu ao SENHOR, e contou-lhe por justiça.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑יו אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר הוֹצֵאתִ֨יךָ֙ מֵא֣וּר כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים לָ֧תֶת לְךָ֛ אֶת־הָאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּ֖את לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: He said to him, “I am Yahweh who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land to inherit it.”
controles.kjv: And he said unto him, I am the Lord that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.
controles.livre: E disse-lhe: Eu sou o SENHOR, que te tirei de Ur dos caldeus, para dar-te a herdar esta terra.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהוִ֔ה בַּמָּ֥ה אֵדַ֖ע כִּ֥י אִֽירָשֶֽׁנָּה׃

controles.web: He said, “Lord Yahweh, how will I know that I will inherit it?”
controles.kjv: And he said, Lord God, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?
controles.livre: E ele respondeu: Senhor DEUS, com que saberei que a vou herdar?

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו קְחָ֥ה לִי֙ עֶגְלָ֣ה מְשֻׁלֶּ֔שֶׁת וְעֵ֥ז מְשֻׁלֶּ֖שֶׁת וְאַ֣יִל מְשֻׁלָּ֑שׁ וְתֹ֖ר וְגוֹזָֽל׃

controles.web: He said to him, “Bring me a heifer three years old, a female goat three years old, a ram three years old, a turtledove, and a young pigeon.”
controles.kjv: And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.
controles.livre: E lhe disse: Separa-me uma bezerra de três anos, e uma cabra de três anos, e um carneiro de três anos, uma rolinha também, e um pombinho.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּֽקַּֽח־ל֣וֹ אֶת־כָּל־אֵ֗לֶּה וַיְבַתֵּ֤ר אֹתָם֙ בַּתָּ֔וֶךְ וַיִּתֵּ֥ן אִישׁ־בִּתְר֖וֹ לִקְרַ֣את רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְאֶת־הַצִפֹּ֖ר לֹ֥א בָתָֽר׃

controles.web: He brought him all of these, and divided them in the middle, and laid each half opposite the other; but he didn’t divide the birds.
controles.kjv: And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided he not.
controles.livre: E tomou ele todas estas coisas, e partiu-as pela metade, e pôs cada metade uma em frente de outra; mas não partiu as aves.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּ֥רֶד הָעַ֖יִט עַל־הַפְּגָרִ֑ים וַיַּשֵּׁ֥ב אֹתָ֖ם אַבְרָֽם׃

controles.web: The birds of prey came down on the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.
controles.kjv: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases, Abram drove them away.
controles.livre: E desciam aves sobre os corpos mortos, e enxotava-as Abrão.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֤י הַשֶּׁ֨מֶשׁ֙ לָב֔וֹא וְתַרְדֵּמָ֖ה נָפְלָ֣ה עַל־אַבְרָ֑ם וְהִנֵּ֥ה אֵימָ֛ה חֲשֵׁכָ֥ה גְדֹלָ֖ה נֹפֶ֥לֶת עָלָֽיו׃

controles.web: When the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell on Abram. Now terror and great darkness fell on him.
controles.kjv: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, an horror of great darkness fell upon him.
controles.livre: Mas ao pôr do sol veio o sono a Abrão, e eis que o pavor de uma grande escuridão caiu sobre ele.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְאַבְרָ֗ם יָדֹ֨עַ תֵּדַ֜ע כִּי־גֵ֣ר׀ יִהְיֶ֣ה זַרְעֲךָ֗ בְּאֶ֨רֶץ֙ לֹ֣א לָהֶ֔ם וַעֲבָד֖וּם וְעִנּ֣וּ אֹתָ֑ם אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָֽה׃

controles.web: He said to Abram, “Know for sure that your seed will live as foreigners in a land that is not theirs, and will serve them. They will afflict them four hundred years.
controles.kjv: And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;
controles.livre: Então disse a Abrão: Tem certeza que a tua descendência será peregrina em terra que não é sua, e serão escravizados e afligidos por quatrocentos anos.

versos.hebraico: וְגַ֧ם אֶת־הַגּ֛וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲבֹ֖דוּ דָּ֣ן אָנֹ֑כִי וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵ֥ן יֵצְא֖וּ בִּרְכֻ֥שׁ גָּדֽוֹל׃

controles.web: I will also judge that nation, whom they will serve. Afterward they will come out with great wealth,
controles.kjv: And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.
controles.livre: Mas também a nação a quem servirão, eu julgarei; e depois disto sairão com grande riqueza.

versos.hebraico: וְאַתָּ֛ה תָּב֥וֹא אֶל־אֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ בְּשָׁל֑וֹם תִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּשֵׂיבָ֥ה טוֹבָֽה׃

controles.web: but you will go to your fathers in peace. You will be buried in a good old age.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.
controles.livre: Tu, porém, virás aos teus pais em paz, e serás sepultado em boa velhice.

versos.hebraico: וְד֥וֹר רְבִיעִ֖י יָשׁ֣וּבוּ הֵ֑נָּה כִּ֧י לֹא־שָׁלֵ֛ם עֲוֺ֥ן הָאֱמֹרִ֖י עַד־הֵֽנָּה׃

controles.web: In the fourth generation they will come here again, for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.”
controles.kjv: But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full.
controles.livre: E na quarta geração voltarão para cá; porque ainda não está completa a maldade dos amorreus até aqui.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֤י הַשֶּׁ֨מֶשׁ֙ בָּ֔אָה וַעֲלָטָ֖ה הָיָ֑ה וְהִנֵּ֨ה תַנּ֤וּר עָשָׁן֙ וְלַפִּ֣יד אֵ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָבַ֔ר בֵּ֖ין הַגְּזָרִ֥ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

controles.web: It came to pass that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold, a smoking furnace, and a flaming torch passed between these pieces.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces.
controles.livre: E sucedeu que, depois de posto o sol, e já estando escuro, apareceu um fogo fumegando, e uma tocha de fogo que passou por entre os animais divididos.

versos.hebraico: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא כָּרַ֧ת יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־אַבְרָ֖ם בְּרִ֣ית לֵאמֹ֑ר לְזַרְעֲךָ֗ נָתַ֨תִּי֙ אֶת־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את מִנְּהַ֣ר מִצְרַ֔יִם עַד־הַנָּהָ֥ר הַגָּדֹ֖ל נְהַר־פְּרָֽת׃

controles.web: In that day Yahweh made a covenant with Abram, saying, “To your seed I have given this land, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:
controles.kjv: In the same day the Lord made a covenant with Abram, saying, Unto thy seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt unto the great river, the river Euphrates:
controles.livre: Naquele dia fez o SENHOR um pacto com Abrão dizendo: À tua descendência darei esta terra desde o rio do Egito até o rio grande, o rio Eufrates;

versos.hebraico: אֶת־הַקֵּינִי֙ וְאֶת־הַקְּנִזִּ֔י וְאֵ֖ת הַקַּדְמֹנִֽי׃

controles.web: the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites,
controles.kjv: The Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kadmonites,
controles.livre: Os queneus, e os quenezeus, e os cadmoneus,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הַחִתִּ֥י וְאֶת־הַפְּרִזִּ֖י וְאֶת־הָרְפָאִֽים׃

controles.web: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim,
controles.kjv: And the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Rephaims,
controles.livre: E os heteus, e os perizeus, e os refains,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הָֽאֱמֹרִי֙ וְאֶת־הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י וְאֶת־הַגִּרְגָּשִׁ֖י וְאֶת־הַיְבוּסִֽי׃ס

controles.web: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.”
controles.kjv: And the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.
controles.livre: E os amorreus, e os cananeus, e os girgaseus, e os jebuseus.
